title: Chef
description:
CHEF DE COZINHA - RESTAURANTE PÉRGULA
Na Belmond e no Copacabana Palace, cada prato é uma verdadeira jornada culinária, elaborada com cuidado e propósito. Nossos menus são criados com criatividade e paixão, e nosso serviço é oferecido com atenção e elegância. Como líder da Cozinha do Pérgula, você garantirá qualidade e excelência em cada detalhe, proporcionando experiências gastronômicas autênticas e de alto nível.
Você elevará sua paixão única pela excelência ao mais alto padrão e se tornará um mestre da sua arte.
Tarefas diárias e responsabilidades
Planejar, elaborar, testar e atualizar cardápios do Restaurante, Serviço de Piscina e Room Service, utilizando fichas técnicas e gerenciando custos.
Liderar e treinar a equipe da cozinha, garantindo cumprimento dos procedimentos internos, segurança de alimentos e uso adequado de EPIs.
Gerir estoque de insumos, materiais e equipamentos, acompanhando validade, conservação, manutenção e realizando previsões de compras e reposições.
Supervisionar todas as etapas da produção de alimentos, assegurando qualidade, higiene e excelência no serviço.
Conduzir entrevistas técnicas, avaliações de desempenho e fornecer feedback contínuo, reconhecendo boas performances e promovendo motivação e espírito de equipe.
Planejar e aplicar treinamentos técnicos, além de participar dos cursos de Segurança de Alimentos.
Zelar pela segurança, assim como pelo correto tratamento e descarte de resíduos.
Requisitos:
Experiência mínima de 7+ anos em hotelaria 5★
all day dining
.
Expertise em cozinha Mediterrânea e Brasileira com visão de gastronomia de luxo.
Experiência sólida com
multi-outlets
(restaurante, room service e piscina).
Capacidade de entrega em grandes volumes, com excelência.
Vivência com padrões LQA (
Leading Quality Assurance
).
Gestão de equipes acima de 40 colaboradores.
Domínio de protocolos HACCP.
Inglês prático, será um diferencial.
Benefícios
Plano de Saúde e Odontológico extensivo a dependentes diretos.
Convênio Farmácia.
Vale transporte.
Alimentação no local.
Seguro de Vida
Folga de Aniversário
Descontos nos pontos de vendas da empresa.
De acordo com o seu “tempo de casa”, você adquiri diárias e experiências gratuitas nas propriedades da empresa ao redor do mundo, incluindo 50% de desconto em Alimentos & Bebidas.
Nos esforçamos para criar um ambiente onde nossas(os) colaboradoras(es) possam prosperar tanto pessoal quanto profissionalmente. Com um compromisso em seu desenvolvimento contínuo, você terá a oportunidade de aprender e crescer ao lado de alguns dos indivíduos mais talentosos do setor. Junte-se a nós e faça parte da criação de momentos inesquecíveis para nossos hóspedes, comunidades e uns aos outros.
Este é o seu momento. Inscreva-se hoje!
Sobre nós
Um refúgio atemporal no coração de uma cidade movimentada. Um estilo de vida cosmopolita encontra o glamour do mundo antigo no Copacabana Palace. Com bares icônicos, restaurantes com estrela Michelin e um Spa estão todos esperando para serem descobertos dentro de suas paredes art déco.
Inicie sua jornada profissional no mundo da hospitalidade no ícone brasileiro à beira-mar com mais de um século de história.
A Belmond & a família LVMH
Nós do Copacabana Palace, somos orgulhosos em fazer parte da LVMH e da coleção global de hotéis, trens e cruzeiros fluviais Belmond, todos criando experiências excepcionais em todo o mundo. Quando você se junta à nossa propriedade, você se torna parte de uma família global de hotéis ricos em história e destinos deslumbrantes, onde nossas(os) colaboradoras(es) estão no centro da experiência Belmond.

title: Staff Frontend Engineer
description:
Who We Are
Cint is a pioneer in research technology (ResTech). Our customers use the Cint platform to post questions and get answers from real people to build business strategies, confidently publish research, accurately measure the impact of digital advertising, and more. The Cint platform is built on a programmatic marketplace, which is the world’s largest, with nearly 300 million respondents in over 150 countries who consent to sharing their opinions, motivations, and behaviours.
We are feeding the world’s curiosity!
Job Description
The Opportunity
Cint is looking to raise the bar on engineering standards as well as user experiences. We offer a smaller company atmosphere, where engineers can shape technical strategy, lead cross-team initiatives, and set the direction for how we build and deliver products at scale. Our products are redefining experiences within the industry—join us to help define the future of our platform while multiplying the impact of the teams around you.
We’re seeking a Staff Frontend Engineer to join our UI Engineering team. This team is focused on providing frontend solutions to multiple projects and tooling to the whole company. We are deeply committed to advancing our frontend architecture (Next.js), ensuring alignment with our Design Systems, and collaborating with backend teams to deliver consistent, reliable, and user-friendly experiences across the platform.
What You Will Do
As a Staff Frontend Engineer, you will join our globally distributed team to shape and elevate Cint’s Measurement, Survey Platform, and Design System experiences. Your mission is to craft high-quality, scalable user interfaces that power our core research products delivering intuitive experiences for our customers while also enabling internal teams to move faster with confidence.
You will be a product-oriented and platform UI engineer, taking full ownership of the end-to-user experience. This includes partnering closely with UX designers, product managers, and fellow engineers to understand customer and stakeholder needs for both external user-facing products and internal products like our survey platform and design systems.
Responsabilities:
Partner closely with Product Managers and UX designers to deliver polished, user-centric experiences and support product rollouts.
Create scalable and maintainable frontend components, while enhancing and extending our shared Design System.
Monitor and optimize application performance, resolving bottlenecks proactively.
Lead cross-team technical initiatives, set architectural direction, and ensure alignment on frontend strategy across the organization.
Proactively shape engineering practices, propose improvements, and influence standards adopted by multiple teams.
Advocate for and document best practices in frontend development.
Own and architect systems or product areas end-to-end, designing solutions that scale across multiple teams and business domains.
Build strong cross-functional relationships to ensure smooth collaboration and alignment.
Write clean, modular, and maintainable code that stands the test of time.
Continuously improve and refactor existing codebases for reliability and efficiency.
Take responsibility for production systems through on-call rotations, ensuring stability and fast incident resolution.
Mentor and sponsor engineers at all levels, building future technical leaders and spreading best practices throughout the company.
Anticipate organizational and architectural challenges, define long-term strategies, and drive adoption of solutions that improve scalability, reliability, and developer experience across Cint.
Qualifications
What We Are Looking For
7+ years of software engineering experience, including significant time driving cross-team technical initiatives and architectural decisions.
Highly proficient in Next.js 14+ (App Router), including expertise in data caching strategies and performance optimization.
Demonstrates proficiency in various UI rendering architectures (SSR, CSR, SSG, ISR) and the ability to determine their appropriate application.
A proven expertise in designing and implementing robust UI solutions using TypeScript, with a strong focus on applying comprehensive typing throughout the stack to deliver maintainable and highly reliable user experiences.
Proficiency in breaking down product documents and abstracts into well-defined feature epics and user stories, driving features from concept to reality promptly.
Experience with CSS and Tailwind, and in working with Figma and internal design systems.
Track record of building reliable, performant systems and establishing testing and quality practices adopted across teams.
Demonstrates strong communication skills, capable of articulating complex technical concepts to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
Proven ability to define and drive technical standards across multiple teams or product lines, aligning stakeholders and ensuring adoption.
Experience balancing trade-offs between technical debt, speed, and long-term scalability in a way that advances organizational goals.
Additional Information
Our Values
Collaboration is our superpower
We uncover rich perspectives across the world
Success happens together
We deliver across borders.
Innovation is in our blood
We’re pioneers in our industry
Our curiosity is insatiable
We bring the best ideas to life.

Excellence comes as standard
We’re open, honest and kind, always.

We learn from each other’s experiences
Stop and listen; every opinion matters
We embrace diversity, equity and inclusion.
More About Cint
We’re proud to be recognised in Newsweek’s 2025 Global Top 100 Most Loved Workplaces, reflecting our commitment to a culture of trust, respect, and employee growth.
In June 2021, Cint acquired Berlin-based GapFish – the world’s largest ISO certified online panel community in the DACH region – and in January 2022, completed the acquisition of US-based Lucid – a programmatic research technology platform that provides access to first-party survey data in over 110 countries.

title: Regional Sales Manager
description:
Our Mission
At Palo Alto Networks everything starts and ends with our mission:
Being the cybersecurity partner of choice, protecting our digital way of life.
Our vision is a world where each day is safer and more secure than the one before. We are a company built on the foundation of challenging and disrupting the way things are done, and we’re looking for innovators who are as committed to shaping the future of cybersecurity as we are.
Who We Are
We take our mission of protecting the digital way of life seriously. We are relentless in protecting our customers and we believe that the unique ideas of every member of our team contributes to our collective success. Our values were crowdsourced by employees and are brought to life through each of us everyday - from disruptive innovation and collaboration, to execution. From showing up for each other with integrity to creating an environment where we all feel included.
As a member of our team, you will be shaping the future of cybersecurity. We work fast, value ongoing learning, and we respect each employee as a unique individual. Knowing we all have different needs, our development and personal wellbeing programs are designed to give you choice in how you are supported. This includes our FLEXBenefits wellbeing spending account with over 1,000 eligible items selected by employees, our mental and financial health resources, and our personalized learning opportunities - just to name a few!
Job Description
Your Career
The Regional Sales Manager is a significant driver of company revenue and growth. As an experienced and dynamic sales professional, you’re responsible for leading and driving sales engagements. You’re motivated by the desire to solve critical challenges facing our customer’s secure environment, so you’re prepared to connect them with a solution for every stage of threat prevention.
You’ll be responsible for meeting and exceeding your quota by crafting and implementing strategic territory plans targeting deployments of the Palo Alto Networks Next Generation Security Platform. This is a unique opportunity for a closer with a go-getter mentality to win business and market share by actively displacing competing technologies.
Palo Alto Networks is leading the charge in platformization, offering best-in-breed solutions that enable customers to build a truly zero-trust security architecture and navigate critical transformations. To ensure our sales team is equipped to guide customers, we've developed FLIGHT, an immersive onboarding program. Flight blends virtual and in-person learning at our headquarters, where new sales hires will participate in dynamic cohorts, fully dedicated to their training without customer distractions. This focused approach ensures they emerge as well-prepared sales professionals, ready to help customers leverage our comprehensive portfolio.
Your Impact

title: IT Network Engineer
description:
Responsibilities:
Based on architecture standards set by the headquarters IT architecture team, test and validate local products, drive procurement execution, and complete device purchases.
Collaborate with the headquarters IT architecture team and local service providers to complete the purchases, installation, configuration, and upgrade of network equipment and low-voltage systems (e.g. CCTV, access control systems, racks, and cabling).
Manage local system integration projects to ensure effective implementation of solutions as guided by headquarters' technical requirements, while optimizing execution according to local needs.
Develop and implement localized IT solutions. Ensure IT infrastructure maintenance and operations align with headquarters standards.
Monitor the quality of office network using tools provided by headquarters IT, gather user feedback, and design and implement corresponding improvements.
Track, manage, and Inventory local IT infrastructure resources (including equipment inventories and supplier collaboration) and resolve local application and service issues, and ensure the integrity of IT infrastructure.
Coordinate local service provider resources to ensure rapid problem resolution and efficient use of personnel, equipment, and time to meet project needs effectively.
Provide standard operating procedures and documentation support, regularly reporting progress on localized solutions to headquarters.
Requirements:
Bachelor’s degree or higher in Computer Science, IT-related fields, or Engineering.
At least 3 years of experience in IT network and data center system integration maintenance.
Familiarity with enterprise-level network architecture and equipment management. Knowledge of routing protocols such as Static Routing, OSPF, and BGP; VPN technologies including GRE, SSL VPN, and IPSec VPN; and wireless authentication protocols like EAP, PEAP, and TLS.
Proficiency in network and system monitoring tools (e.g. Zabbix, Grafana) and experience in operations automation tools.
Experience in managing CCTV, access control systems, facial recognition devices, and UPS systems is preferred.
Familiarity with key brands of switches, wireless APs, cameras, access control systems, racks and cables, with knowledge of their strengths and weaknesses.
Proven experience in developing and implementing IT solutions, with the ability to optimize execution based on practical requirements.
Strong communication and collaboration skills to effectively work with suppliers and headquarters IT teams.
Fluency in both Chinese and English, or Arabic and English, for effective communication is preferred.
Possession of relevant technical certifications (e.g. CCIE) or project management certifications (e.g. PMP) is an advantage.

description:
Explore the Nearsure experience!

– Enjoy an extra day off during your birthday week to celebrate in style with friends and family!
About the project:
As a
Staff Database Engineer (AWS)
, you will lead the design and optimization of our global, multi-cloud data infrastructure. This role requires deep technical expertise across AWS, Azure, and modern data stack tools, along with the ability to architect, scale, and govern complex data systems that span regions and business units.
How you'll contribute
Architect and manage scalable, fault-tolerant, and high-performance data pipelines using AWS Glue, Step Functions, Lambda, Azure Data Factory, and Python.
Design and implement global data infrastructure across multiple regions, optimizing for latency, availability, and compliance with international data standards.
Own and evolve the architecture of core databases and warehouses, including Snowflake, PostgreSQL, MySQL, DynamoDB, DocumentDB, and MongoDB.
Lead and oversee data migrations between cloud platforms (AWS, Azure), legacy systems, and global regions with minimal downtime and high data integrity.
Define standards for indexing, query optimization, partitioning, and sharding strategies to support high-throughput and low-latency workloads.
Champion observability by implementing and scaling monitoring, alerting, and dashboards via CloudWatch, Azure Monitor, Datadog, or similar tools.
Orchestrate transformations using DBT or Coalesce, maintaining strong data lineage, validation, and governance across workflows.
Collaborate cross-functionally with Engineering, DevOps, and Analytics teams to deliver data solutions that are secure, reliable, and cost-efficient.
Mentor engineers in best practices for database performance, automation, and data reliability.
Drive automation and operational excellence through CLI tools, APIs, infrastructure-as-code (Terraform, CloudFormation, or Bicep), and CI/CD pipelines.
Ensure data quality and compliance by implementing validation frameworks, automated testing, and consistent documentation across systems.
This would make you the ideal candidate
Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.
6+ Years of experience working as Data Engineer, Database Engineer, or Cloud Data Architect.
Proven AWS hands-on expertise, especially with Glue, Step Functions and Lambda.
Strong Python and SQL skills for workflow development and optimization.
Experience designing and maintaining data pipelines (ETL/ELT).
Proven data migration experience (cross-cloud or hybrid, with minimal downtime).
Hands-on with data orchestration tools (e.g., Glue, Step Functions).
Solid experience with at least two database systems among: Snowflake, PostgreSQL, MySQL, DynamoDB, MongoDB.
Experience with monitoring and observability tools (CloudWatch, Azure Monitor, or Datadog).
Excellent communication and collaboration skills with technical and non-technical teams.
Azure experience (Data Factory, Synapse, Functions, Monitor).
Infrastructure-as-Code (IaC) tools such as Terraform, CloudFormation, or Bicep.
Experience implementing cost governance frameworks in cloud data environments.
Hands-on with data transformation tools (DBT or Coalesce).
Deep understanding of performance tuning and scaling optimization for both relational and NoSQL databases.
Experience mentoring or guiding engineers in best practices.
Strong grasp of data quality and validation frameworks.
Knowledge of partitioning, indexing, and sharding strategies for performance optimization.
Exposure to CI/CD pipelines for data engineering projects.
Advanced English Level is required for this role, as you will work with US clients. Effective communication in English is essential to deliver the best solutions to our clients and expand your horizons.

A customer-centric approach to understanding and meeting needs effectively.

Procuramos um profissional apaixonado por vendas consultivas e com forte orientação ao cliente para atuar como Executivo de Vendas de Canal Indireto na KARL STORZ. Essa pessoa será responsável por impulsionar o crescimento de mercado em seu território, promovendo todo o portfólio de soluções da empresa, desenvolvendo relacionamentos sólidos com clientes e garantindo uma experiência excepcional em saúde.

A KARL STORZ Endoskope é uma empresa alemã, líder em soluções inovadoras e tecnologia de ponta na área médica. Fundada em 1945 pelo Dr. Karl Storz em Tuttlingen, Alemanha, segue seu compromisso com a qualidade e inovação no mercado de equipamentos médicos mundial. Atualmente, a KARL STORZ emprega cerca de 9.800 colaboradores ao redor do mundo e vem crescendo exponencialmente a cada ano. Fundada no Brasil em 2009, era responsável pelo marketing e pelo apoio da distribuição de toda a região. Em meados de 2022 iniciaram as operações de fato no Brasil, contratando uma equipe especializada para apoiar no crescimento da empresa na América Latina.

Vale Refeição (R$ 945,00) e Vale Alimentação (R$300,00)
Plano de Saúde e Odontológico Bradesco
Total Pass
C4 Life - Assistência psicológica, financeira, jurídica e social.

Desenvolver venda de soluções e construir uma posição de liderança de mercado sustentável em cada especialidade, incluindo nosso negócio de serviços.

Fornecer relatórios periódicos à Gerência de Vendas gerado através de CRM, avaliando o desempenho e os sucessos na semana/mês, o progresso atual com os objetivos, destacando as principais atividades, juntamente com quaisquer problemas conhecidos ou previstos.
Garantir a consolidação/atualização do forecast da sua área de atuação, através do CRM, visando suportar a estratégia de vendas elaborada pela liderança.
Desenvolver laços fortes com clientes-chave e ser proativo na compreensão das tendências e questões que provavelmente impactarão o mercado.
Desenvolver estratégias-chave para contas e clientes significativos, mantendo ou aumentando as margens brutas e colaborando com propostas da gestão para a decisão final.
Estabelecer contato com a equipe de suporte ao cliente e a divisão de treinamento para garantir que os clientes recebam todo o suporte necessários.
Promove e estabelece a educação dos produtos e/ou serviços da empresa.

Responsabilidade – Responsável por alcançar resultados e atingir os objetivos.
Priorização e foco - identifica e comunica prioridades, marcos, cronogramas, medidas de desempenho e responsabilidades claras.

CNH válida para recebimento do veículo corporativo como ferramenta de trabalho

Pode fornecer orientação e assistência a profissionais de vendas de nível básico e/ou funcionários de suporte.
70% do tempo visitando clientes (SP) e 30% escritório.

O profissional será peça-chave na sustentação de pipelines, automação de deploys, governança de APIs e segurança das integrações, assegurando performance e integridade dos fluxos críticos de dados.
Seus desafios serão:
Projetar, implementar e manter pipelines de integração entre o SAP (ERP e IS-U HANA) e sistemas legados, utilizando ferramentas modernas de automação e orquestração.
Garantir que todas as integrações respeitem os padrões de segurança da informação, auditoria, criptografia e compliance regulatório.
Desenvolver e monitorar APIs, middlewares (SAP PI/PO, CPI, etc.), conectores e mensagerias (ex: Kafka, RabbitMQ), assegurando o funcionamento contínuo dos fluxos de dados.
Estabelecer boas práticas de versionamento, CI/CD, segregação de ambientes, testes automatizados e rollback.
Trabalhar em conjunto com os times de BASIS, segurança, infraestrutura, desenvolvimento ABAP/Java e fornecedores externos.
Apoiar o controle de acesso a serviços de integração, utilizando mecanismos como OAuth2, certificados digitais, SAML, etc.
Monitorar, diagnosticar e resolver falhas nos pipelines de integração com foco em resiliência.
Documentar fluxos, endpoints, dependências e procedimentos operacionais.
O que é necessário você ter:
Ensino superior completo em áreas de TI.
Experiência com ferramentas e práticas DevSecOps aplicadas a projetos SAP e/ou integrações corporativas.
Domínio de CI/CD pipelines (GitLab CI, Jenkins, Azure DevOps, etc.).
Conhecimento em SAP PI/PO, SAP Cloud Platform Integration (CPI), API Management, IDoc, RFC/BAPI, ODATA e WebServices.
Experiência com integração segura ( JWT, certificados, SSO, firewalls).
Conhecimento em containers (Docker) e orquestração (Kubernetes, OpenShift).
Experiência com sistemas de mensageria (Kafka, RabbitMQ, etc.).
Automação de testes e validações em integrações.
Conhecimento em monitoramento de logs e métricas (ELK, Grafana, Prometheus, etc.).
Familiaridade com ambientes SAP híbridos (cloud/on-premise).
Conhecimento prévio de integrações com sistemas de utilities (ex: sistemas de medição, CRM legado, gestão de redes, etc.).
Experiência com SAP Business Technology Platform (BTP).

title: Project Engineer
description:

(ENGLISH SPEAKERS)

and
energy transmission projects
across global markets.
We're looking for an experienced Project Engineer to support the design, development, and delivery of substation and high-voltage projects. Key Responsibilities:
Develop basic and executive electromechanical designs for high-voltage substations (69kV to 500kV)
Prepare and analyze layout drawings, grounding mesh, cable routing, and auxiliary systems (AC/DC)
Design single-line, three-line, and interconnection diagrams
Ensure compliance with international standards (IEC, ANSI, IEEE, ABNT)

Interface with clients, suppliers, and cross-functional engineering teams
Contribute to engineering reports including ROI, CAPEX, and technical feasibility
What We’re Looking For:
Degree in Electrical Engineering or related field
Minimum 4+ years of experience
in high-voltage substation design (preferred: 230kV to 500kV)
Proficiency with AutoCAD (See Electrical, Eplan P8 or similar is a plus)
Familiarity with SCADA, protection and control systems
Solid knowledge of substation equipment: CTs, PTs, surge arresters, circuit breakers, transformers, disconnectors
Experience with software like CYMCAP, DiaLUX, PVsyst (nice to have)
Strong communication skills and ability to work in multicultural environments
English proficiency required; Portuguese or Spanish is a plus
Bonus:
Experience with renewable projects (photovoltaic farms, hybrid systems)
Exposure to EPC projects and multidisciplinary coordination
Understanding of ESG practices in engineering
Why Join Us:
Work with industry leaders in power and energy systems
Get involved in international projects with real impact
Grow within a dynamic and mission-driven company
Remote flexibility and a collaborative, innovation-driven culture
Who is Xelvin?
Xelvin is a Dutch consultancy company specializing in Engineering and Technical Trades. We hire Artisans, National Degree, Bachelor, Masters and PHD candidates with a background in Mechatronics, Electronics, Electrical, Mechanical, Automotive and Physics. Our focus is within the High-Tech and Manufacturing industry in Eindhoven region.
Xelvin is specialized in International Recruitment, within Europe and beyond. In the past years we have helped over a thousand candidates from more than 50 different nationalities with finding their perfect job here in the Netherlands and are striving to help so many more!
As Xelvin we hire candidates for a specific position for a set amount of time, after which a permanent contract with our client is granted and the candidates automatically transfers.
What do we offer?
Contract wise:
· 1-2 year contract of 40 hours per week (with potential of long-term employment).
· 25 paid holidays a year (+ potential ADV days)
· Public holidays, with a maximum of 7 per year, which are paid by Xelvin.
· Holiday allowance of 8.33% (instead of 8,0%) over your total gross annual income. Paid each year in May.
· Overtime and shift allowance will be paid by Xelvin accordingly.
· Travel allowance of €0,23 per km, for the use of travelling to work and back home.
· Competitive salary (based on level of education and experience)
Onboarding & benefits:
· Your 1st house in the Netherlands will be supported by Xelvin, with the help of our Housing Consultant (we help you find accommodation). In case of having to pay the 1st months rent or potential deposit, Xelvin is willing to pay it for you upfront, after which we’ll set up a loan agreement, for you to pay us back in terms.
· A relocation assistance allowance of €1000 - €3000,00 NET will be paid to you, to assist with the cost of relocating to the Netherlands.
· You (and your family/partner) will be picked up at the airport or train station by your consultant/ recruiter after your arrival and will be taken to your new house.
· Onboarding: we’ll advise you on how to set up a Dutch bank account, apply for health insurance, getting a Dutch BSN number, writing in with a dentist and general practitioner and other useful or necessary cases to arrange.
· New Hire Dinner organized for all newly recruited engineers to make them aware of our Dutch tax system and explaining the Dutch payslip.
· A few social gatherings with all Xelvin employees and recruited engineers;
o New Years drink at the local PSV stadium, where you’ll get a tour of the building and beverages and bites are served.
o Summer BBQ at the Evoluon, where you can grow your social circle and dance to some nice music while enjoying the food.

title: Lead Engineer - Work from home
description:
Explore the Nearsure experience!
Join our close-knit LATAM remote team:

Ready to grow with us?
Here’s what we offer you by joining us!
Competitive USD salary
– We value your skills and contributions!
100% remote work

Paid time off – Take the time you need according to your country’s regulations, all while receiving your full salary. Rest, recharge, and come back stronger!

Birthday day off
– Enjoy an extra day off during your birthday week to celebrate in style with friends and family!
About the project:
As a
Lead Engineer (Installed Apps)
, you will take charge of our classic C# desktop applications while supporting the M365 migration strategy. This role combines hands-on technical leadership with team mentorship during a pivotal transformation period.
How you'll contribute
Oversee daily operations and coordinate work across a distributed team (multiple time zones).
Lead release management and escalation handling for enterprise customers.
Conduct performance reviews, career development, and team capacity planning.
Mentor engineers, provide coaching, and support professional growth.
Participate in recruiting and hiring for desktop development and enterprise integration roles.
Collaborate with product management to refine requirements and prioritize work.
Facilitate technical discussions, architecture decisions, and cross-team collaboration.
Manage customer relationships and provide technical leadership during escalations.
Define architectural designs for desktop-to-cloud migration.
Build compliance frameworks for enterprise security.
Design backward compatibility strategies during platform transitions.
Implement performance monitoring and reporting systems.
Plan technical debt reduction while ensuring production stability.
Develop API integration patterns for enterprise platform services.
Develop and maintain desktop applications using C#/.NET, WPF, and Win32.
Build Office Add-ins (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook) for enterprise integration.
Architect email client solutions with advanced features (e.g., encryption, folder mapping).
Implement file synchronization, document import/export, and installer systems (MSI, WiX).
Integrate authentication (OAuth 2.0, SAML, Azure AD) and enterprise security features.
Optimize multi-threaded applications for high-volume document processing.
Work with REST APIs and cloud services for connectivity.
Maintain legacy codebases while guiding modernization efforts.
This would make you the ideal candidate
Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.
7+ Years of experience working in Windows desktop development with C#/.NET (Framework and Core/5+), including hands-on work with WPF, WinForms, or Win32 APIs.
3+ Years of experience building Microsoft Office integrations (VSTO, COM Interop, or Office Add-ins for Word, Excel, Outlook).
3+ Years of experience working with enterprise authentication systems such as OAuth 2.0, SAML, and Azure Active Directory.
3+ Years of experience working with email protocols (IMAP, SMTP, Exchange Web Services, Microsoft Graph).
3+ Years of experience working in team leadership/management, leading at least 5 engineers, including mentoring, code reviews, and performance management.
2+ Years of experience working with installer/deployment technologies (WiX, MSI, or MSIX).
Cloud integration experience (Azure preferred, AWS acceptable).
Office 365 / Microsoft 365 add-in development.
Enterprise security implementations such as S/MIME, encryption, or digital signatures.
Experience with document management system integrations.
Experience with high-volume file processing and synchronization systems.
Advanced English Level is required for this role, as you will work with US clients. Effective communication in English is essential to deliver the best solutions to our clients and expand your horizons.
What to expect from our hiring process
1. Let’s chat about your experience!
2. Impress our recruiters, and you’ll move on to a technical interview with our top developers.
3. Nail that, and you’ll meet our client - your final step to joining our amazing team!
At Nearsure, we’re dedicated to solving complex business challenges through cutting-edge technology and we believe in the power of tailored solutions. Whether you are passionate about transforming businesses with Generative AI, building innovative software products, or implementing comprehensive enterprise platform solutions, we invite you to be part of our dynamic team!
We would love to hear from you if you are eager to make an impact and join a collaborative team that values creativity and expertise.
Let’s work together to shape the future of technology!
Apply now!

Familiarity with version control systems (e.g., Git) and CI/CD pipelines.
Hands-on experience deploying containerized AI applications using Docker and orchestrating services with Kubernetes.
Experience evaluating the performance, reliability, and security of GenAI systems.
Advanced English Level is required for this role as you will work with US clients. Effective communication in English is essential to deliver the best solutions to our clients and expand your horizons.

Nos últimos 12 meses tivemos mais de 22 mil alunos interessados em fazer aulas conosco. Professores novos têm lotado suas agendas em até 30 dias, quando são comprometidos, se comunicam de forma eficaz e tem agenda no horário da noite disponível.

  • Acesso exclusivo a uma plataforma com mais de 400 vídeos de treinamento, baseada em uma metodologia que já entregou resultados incríveis, com vídeos totalmente atualizados .

Como saber se você é a pessoa certa para fazer parte da maior comunidade de professores independentes do Brasil?

title: Administrative Assistant
description:
Join the Virtual Latinos Community!


With over 5,000+ VA's hired that are part of our community and 2,500+ companies helped , Virtual Latinos stands out as the first American company connecting exceptional virtual professionals from Latin America with small businesses and entrepreneurs across the US, Canada, and beyond.

Apply today and become part of a community where your skills shine and your career aspirations soar!


Highlight Job of the Week!


Job Title: Administrative Assistant


Pay Rate LinkedIn style:


Part-Time Monthly Rates : $800 - $1,280 (based on 20 hours per week schedule)

Full-Time Monthly Rates : $1,600 - $2,560 (based on 40 hours per week schedule)


The monthly salary range posted is stipulated as an average monthly income. However, all jobs at Virtual Latinos are hourly-based, and payments are calculated on the number of hours a person works daily. We pay our Virtual Professionals every 2 weeks through third-party platforms. The hourly rate range of the position is $10- $16 depending on experience. Once a rate has been offered to you, it is non-negotiable.



Work Schedule:


The work schedule will vary depending on the job position that you will apply for as it will be based on the schedule requested by the client. All our clients are in the U.S. and work schedules will be in the U.S. time zone.


Job Summary:


The Administrative Assistant will be responsible for providing administrative and customer service support, helping to coordinate schedules, maintain communication with internal and external teams, and manage tasks in a dynamic environment. The ideal candidate will be tech-savvy, detail-oriented, and proactive, supporting the client in a variety of tasks to ensure smooth daily operations.


Job Tasks:


  • Calendar Management: Organize schedules, book meetings, and keep calendars up to date.
  • Email Management: Review, prioritize, and organize emails professionally.
  • Task Tracking: Monitor tasks and deadlines using project management tools.
  • Documentation: Prepare reports, take meeting notes, and maintain organized digital files.
  • Customer Support: Communicate with clients and teams via email, chat, and phone as needed.
  • Research Assistance: Support with gathering information and summarizing findings when required.
  • General Admin: Assist with ad-hoc administrative and support tasks as assigned.


Qualifications:


  • 1 year of related experience and/or a related degree.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English.
  • Ability to excel in a fast-paced environment.
  • Strong organizational abilities.
  • Meticulous attention to detail.
  • Collaborative team spirit.
  • Commitment to confidentiality.
  • A quiet, private workspace.
  • Must be at least 21 years old.


Software:


  • Google Workspace (Gmail, Calendar, Drive, Docs, Sheets, etc.)
  • WhatsApp
  • Asana
  • Miro
  • Canva
  • AI tools (flexible)
  • Open to other tools as needed


Languages:


  • English mandatory
  • Portuguese mandatory


Next Steps:


  • Send your easy apply
  • We will reach out and send you a form to send in your full application
  • Get accepted into our community to have access to all our job offers
  • Apply to job offers of your interest
  • Get interviewed
  • Start working in your dream job!

Audaces Moldes.

title: Senior Wordpress Developer
description:
About Flatiron Software Co.

Flatiron is a fully remote, US-based software company delivering high-impact, modern digital experiences. We work with mission-driven organizations, media groups, and product teams to build scalable, accessible, and performant web platforms. We're currently seeking full-stack developers to join our engineering team, with a strong emphasis on deep WordPress and modern JavaScript experience .


About the Role

We’re looking for a highly skilled Senior WordPress Developer to join our global engineering team. This position focuses on backend development — building and optimizing custom WordPress plugins, APIs, and integrations for large-scale, high-performance websites.

The ideal candidate has deep knowledge of WordPress internals, experience working with enterprise clients, and a strong understanding of scalable, maintainable code.


Responsibilities

  • Design and develop custom WordPress plugins and themes from scratch using PHP, MySQL, and modern best practices.
  • Implement advanced custom fields (ACF) , custom post types , and taxonomies for structured data management.
  • Optimize database queries and improve performance across complex WordPress sites (meta queries, caching, indexing).
  • Integrate WordPress with third-party APIs and automation tools (REST, webhook systems, Make/Zapier, Algolia, etc.).
  • Develop and maintain cron jobs , background tasks, and data synchronization scripts.
  • Build and maintain Gutenberg blocks or React-based admin components when required.
  • Ensure sites meet performance, accessibility, and SEO standards (Lighthouse, Core Web Vitals).
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams (frontend, DevOps, QA, design) following Agile practices.
  • Write clean, well-documented, and unit-tested code following OOP principles and WordPress coding standards.

Minimum Qualifications

  • 5+ years of professional WordPress development experience , focusing on backend and custom plugin work.
  • Strong proficiency in PHP, MySQL, HTML, CSS, and JavaScript .
  • Experience with WordPress hooks (actions & filters) , custom queries, and optimization strategies.
  • Proficient in ACF , CPT UI , Gutenberg , and WooCommerce .
  • Solid understanding of WordPress REST API , webhooks , and API integrations .
  • Familiarity with version control (Git) and CI/CD pipelines .
  • Experience with performance optimization , caching mechanisms, and scalable WordPress architectures.
  • Advanced written and spoken English (international client communication required).


Benefits

- Yearly Office Allowance Budget

- Macbook Purchase Support

- Wellbeing Support


If you think that you are a good fit for the position, please apply through LinkedIn.

Only CVs that are in English will be accepted.


Flatiron Software Co has a zero tolerance to discrimination policy. In this regard, during the course of the evaluation of your job application and during all your employment relation, if any, all discriminatory factors such as race, sex, sexual orientation, social gender definitions/roles, colour, national or social background, ethnicity, religion, age, disablement, political opinion or any status that is protected under law shall be totally disregarded.

title: CRM Architect
description:
We are currently looking for a seasoned CRM Architect to join our dynamic team. This remote role is an exciting opportunity for a professional with a strong background in Microsoft Dynamics CRM development and leadership skills. The ideal candidate will possess a deep understanding of CRM architecture, be experienced in crafting customer-facing pages, and be adept at leading a team of junior developers. As a key player in our organization, you will drive the development and integration of CRM solutions to enhance our customer engagement and streamline business processes.


Job Duties and Responsibilities:


- Lead the development and implementation of Microsoft Dynamics CRM solutions, ensuring alignment with business goals and user needs.

- Design, build, and maintain customer-facing pages on the CRM Portal using both out-of-the-box capabilities and customizations.

- Oversee the CRM data model creation and participate actively in its design and maintenance.

- Conduct code reviews, mentor junior developers, and provide expert guidance on best practices in CRM development.

- Collaborate with cross-functional teams to integrate CRM with Azure, Power Automate, and other essential systems.

- Develop and deploy custom applications within Dynamics CRM, ensuring high performance and adherence to business requirements.

- Facilitate seamless integration of CRM with other systems, ensuring data consistency and accessibility.

- Troubleshoot and resolve complex technical issues related to the CRM environment.

- Keep abreast of new CRM features and technologies, advocating for the adoption of innovations that can benefit the organization.


Qualifications:


- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field.

- 5-12 years of experience in CRM development, with a focus on Microsoft Dynamics CRM.

- Proven track record as a lead developer with experience in guiding and mentoring junior team members.

- Strong understanding of CRM architecture and data modeling principles.

- Professional experience in developing CRM Portals with a blend of out-of-the-box and custom solutions.

- Expertise in HTML, JavaScript, and CSS for portal development.


Preferred Skills and Knowledge:

title: Desenvolvimento de Negócios Globais - Especialistas em Varejo
description:
Se você já liderou no varejo - na loja ou na sede - queremos falar com você.


Sim, somos uma empresa de tecnologia.


Não, você não precisa ter experiência em tecnologia.


Na STOREE.AI, criamos uma plataforma que permite que os gerentes se dupliquem em uma versão com inteligência artificial - um gêmeo digital capaz de liderar equipes, atribuir tarefas, acompanhar KPIs e treinar colaboradores.


Já somos utilizados por mais de 100 redes de lojas.


A tecnologia funciona.


Agora precisamos de pessoas que entendem de varejo para ajudar outros a entender como fazer isso funcionar para eles.


Por que a experiência em varejo é importante:


Nossa plataforma é ampla - ela pode fazer muita coisa.


Mas o que funciona bem para uma rede pode ser completamente diferente para outra.


Uma rede de cosméticos precisa de ferramentas diferentes das de um supermercado.


Um diretor de VM enxerga valor em funcionalidades diferentes das que importam para um head de RH ou de operações.


É por isso que não queremos vendedores.


Queremos profissionais de varejo que possam:


  • Entender as necessidades de uma rede
  • Guiá-los na criação do seu próprio gestor com IA
  • Ajudar nosso time interno a posicionar a solução certa para cada marca
  • Falar a linguagem do varejo, não jargões tecnológicos


Este é um desenvolvimento de negócios com profundidade - porque conhecer o varejo é o que faz tudo isso funcionar.


O que você vai realmente fazer:


  • Construir uma carteira de varejistas relevantes
  • Usar nossas ferramentas de IA (nós te ensinamos) para iniciar conversas
  • Explicar como a STOREE.AI resolve os desafios específicos de cada negócio
  • Guiar o processo ou repassá-lo para nosso time quando necessário
  • Ajudar a moldar o ajuste do produto internamente - você será nosso olhar de varejo


Você não vai fazer pitch.

Vai conectar, guiar e traduzir entre dois mundos.


Para quem é essa oportunidade:


  • Líderes distritais e regionais
  • Profissionais de sede nas áreas de operações, treinamento, RH, marketing ou excelência no varejo
  • Pessoas que lideraram operações de loja, VM ou experiência do cliente
  • Qualquer pessoa que entende como gerenciar lojas - e quer dar o próximo passo na carreira


Se você já disse: “A tecnologia não entende como é a realidade aqui na ponta” - nós concordamos.


É por isso que queremos você do nosso lado.


O que oferecemos:


  • Treinamento completo - não é necessária experiência em tecnologia
  • Trabalho remoto, com horários flexíveis
  • Comissões por resultados + possibilidade de efetivação em tempo integral
  • Trabalhar com uma empresa prestes a escalar globalmente
  • Fazer parte de algo real - nada de teoria


Isso não é um emprego. É a sua segunda carreira.

De especialista em varejo a líder em tecnologia.

De gerenciar equipes a liderar transformações.

title: Talent Acquisition Manager LATAM
description:
About our company:


Werfen: Global Leader in In Vitro Diagnostics

Founded in 1966, Werfen is one of the world's leading companies in the development, manufacturing, and distribution of specialized diagnostic instruments, reagents, process automation solutions, and data management systems that empower patient care in hospitals and laboratories worldwide.

Our solutions in Hemostasis, Acute Care Diagnostics, Autoimmunity, Transplantation, and Transfusion are available in over 100 countries and territories through our direct operations and distributors. We are a team of more than 7,000 employees with an annual revenue exceeding $2 billion , reflecting our global presence in the industry.


Position Summary:


The Talent Acquisition Manager LATAM will be responsible for leading the regional strategy for talent attraction and selection, ensuring structured, transparent, and business-aligned recruitment processes. The role’s mission is to build a standardized recruitment model for LATAM, guaranteeing quality, efficiency, compliance with KPIs, and alignment with Werfen’s culture, acting as a strategic partner to local and regional leaders. The objective is to strengthen the employer brand, attract high-performing talent who embody our values, and promote diversity and inclusion. The manager will serve as a strategic partner to the LATAM People Director and local leaders, ensuring that talent acquisition drives the company’s transformation and expertise in diagnostics.


Key Responsibilities

Talent Acquisition Strategy

  • Lead a unified LATAM recruitment strategy, aligned with global standards and local regulations.
  • Position Werfen as an employer of choice, promoting our culture, values, and purpose.
  • Drive fairness, transparency, and consistency across all hiring processes.

Recruitment Excellence & Innovation

  • Manage end-to-end recruitment with agility and strong candidate experience.
  • Integrate digital tools (ATS, AI, video interviews) to improve quality of hire.
  • Track key KPIs and ensure structured feedback for candidates and managers.

Employer Branding & Inclusion

  • Act as a Werfen brand ambassador, enhancing visibility in the healthcare sector.
  • Foster diversity, equity, and inclusion across all talent initiatives.
  • Strengthen partnerships with universities and professional networks.

Business Partnership & Insights

  • Partner with People BPs and leaders to align talent needs with business goals.
  • Provide data-driven insights and market intelligence for strategic decisions.
  • Champion onboarding excellence and post-hire follow-ups days).


Knowledge & Experience:

  • Bachelor’s degree
  • Additional certifications or training in Talent Management or Leadership are a plus.
  • 8–10 years of experience in recruitment, with 5+ years leading Talent Acquisition in a regional LATAM scope .
  • Experience in the healthcare, diagnostics, or pharmaceutical industry preferred.
  • Demonstrated success implementing standardized TA processes in multicultural environments.
  • Proficiency in digital recruitment tools, ATS platforms, assessments, and analytics .
  • Strong knowledge of LATAM labor markets and local recruitment regulations .


Core Competencies and Skills


  • Assertive communication and negotiation with candidates and leaders.
  • Results-oriented with a sense of urgency and ability to manage multiple priorities.
  • Strong influencing skills and change-agent mindset.
  • Relationship-building and collaboration across diverse teams.
  • Data-driven and strategic, translating insights into impactful actions.
  • Innovative and critical thinker with continuous improvement focus.
  • Fluent in English, Spanish, and Portuguese (mandatory).

title: Senior Golang Engineer
description:
At Avenue Code, we are passionate about transforming businesses through technology. We are a leading end-to-end development consultancy for digital transformation across various markets, growing sustainably since day one. We believe that great results are born from strong relationships. Our team combines technical expertise, collaboration, and a welcoming approach to work that makes all the difference.



About the Opportunity

We are looking for Backend Engineers (Golang) to join Cloudflare’s Billing Engineering team , a critical group responsible for powering all internal and external billing services — including customer onboarding, subscription management, payments, provisioning, and integrations with enterprise systems such as Anaplan, Oracle, Workday, and NetSuite .

We are seeking engineers who can ramp up quickly and deliver impact from day one. The team works in a modern, container-based, microservices environment built primarily in Golang , using Kafka, Kubernetes, and PostgreSQL at scale.


You’ll be part of a collaborative 6-member team with additional developers supporting from adjacent projects. The environment promotes mentorship, knowledge sharing, and autonomy — you’ll never be left alone, but you’ll have the space to take ownership and drive meaningful results.


Responsibilities

  • Design, build, and maintain Golang-based microservices that power Cloudflare’s billing systems.
  • Develop and integrate RESTful APIs that interface with external financial and operational systems.
  • Work with event-driven systems and streaming architectures using Kafka .
  • Manage containerized deployments using Kubernetes and Docker .
  • Collaborate with internal stakeholders across teams to deliver new features and maintain operational excellence.
  • Diagnose, troubleshoot, and resolve production issues across distributed systems.
  • Participate in code reviews, technical discussions, and architecture planning sessions.
  • Contribute to continuous improvement of system reliability, scalability, and security.


Required Qualifications

  • 5+ years of professional backend development experience.
  • Strong hands-on experience with Golang (or proven ability to quickly ramp up).
  • Experience designing and maintaining RESTful APIs and backend microservices.
  • Solid understanding of SQL and relational databases (PostgreSQL or MySQL).
  • Proficiency with Kubernetes and Docker for container orchestration and deployment.
  • Familiarity with event-driven systems (Kafka or similar).
  • Experience working in Unix/Linux environments.
  • Strong debugging and problem-solving skills.
  • Excellent communication and collaboration abilities.
  • Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, agile environment with multiple stakeholders.


Nice to Have Skills

  • Experience integrating with ERP systems such as Oracle, Workday, Anaplan, or NetSuite .
  • Familiarity with API standards and tools (Swagger/OpenAPI, OAuth, JWT).
  • Exposure to Temporal or similar orchestration tools.
  • Knowledge of distributed systems , security best practices , and observability .
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or equivalent practical experience.
  • Passion for building reliable, scalable, and user-centric systems at global scale.


Avenue Code ensures the privacy of all candidates in compliance with regulations such as GDPR, LGPD, CCPA, and CPRA. The data will be used solely for recruitment processes and may be shared, in a limited manner, with clients and CompassUOL Group companies when necessary to provide services.

title: English Language Specialist
description:
iMerit seeks detail-oriented and analytically minded Multimodal GenAI Evaluation Analysts to perform highly nuanced evaluations of AI system outputs across different modalities: text, image, video, and multimodal interactions. Analysts will assess the accuracy, appropriateness, quality, clarity, and cultural alignment of model outputs against complex guidelines, ensuring that results align with project standards and real-world use cases. These evaluations will directly inform the development and fine-tuning of advanced large language models (LLMs), vision models (LVMs), and multimodal AI systems.


Role Responsibilities:

  • Evaluate outputs generated by LLMs across multiple modalities (text, image captions, video descriptions, and multimodal prompts).
  • Assess quality against project-specific criteria such as correctness, coherence, completeness, style, cultural appropriateness, and safety.
  • Identify subtle errors, hallucinations, or biases in AI responses.
  • Apply domain expertise and logical reasoning to resolve ambiguous or unclear outputs.
  • Provide detailed written feedback, tagging, and scoring of outputs to ensure consistency across the evaluation team.
  • Escalate unclear cases and contribute to refining evaluation guidelines.
  • Collaborate with Project Managers and Quality Leads to meet accuracy, reliability, and turnaround benchmarks.


Skills & Competencies:

  • Strong critical reading, observational, and evaluative skills across different modalities.
  • Ability to articulate nuanced judgments with precision and clarity.
  • Excellent English comprehension (CEFR B2 or above); additional languages a plus.
  • Familiarity with LLMs, generative AI, and multimodal systems.
  • Strong attention to detail and ability to apply guidelines consistently.
  • Awareness of cultural and linguistic nuances, including potential bias and harm in AI outputs.
  • Comfort with evolving workflows, rapid feedback cycles, and complex quality frameworks.


Requirements:

  • Bachelor's degree/ diploma or equivalent educational qualification.
  • 1+ years of experience in data annotation, LLM evaluation, content moderation, or related AI/ML domains.
  • Demonstrated experience working with data annotation tools and software platforms.
  • Strong understanding of language and multimodal communication (instruction following in image generation, fact-checking, narrative coherence in video, etc.).
  • Ability to adapt quickly to changing project directions and fast-paced work environments.
  • Previous experience creating or annotating complex data specifically for Large Language Model (LLM) training.
  • Prior exposure to generative AI, prompt engineering, or LLM fine-tuning workflows is a plus.

While moderation of high-harm/high-risk material is not part of this role, candidates should be aware that occasional exposure to NSFW or otherwise sensitive content may occur due to imperfections in client-provided datasets. Applicants should indicate that they are comfortable working in environments where such incidental exposure is a possibility.


What We Offer:

  • Opportunities to shape the evaluation standards for next-generation multimodal AI systems.
  • Innovative and supportive global working environment.
  • Competitive compensation and flexible remote working arrangements.
  • Continuous learning and growth in applied AI evaluation.

Join iMerit to help shape the benchmarks and standards that ensure AI systems are accurate, safe, and culturally aware across text, vision, and multimodal applications. If rigorous analysis and innovation excite you, we encourage you to apply!

Known for its innovative approach and cutting-edge technology, the company specializes in the design, manufacture, and maintenance of Landing Gears. With a strong focus on quality and safety, we have established ourselves as a trusted partner to many major airlines and military organizations worldwide. We are committed to continuous improvement and sustainability, investing heavily in research and development to drive the industry forward.


About the job:


The Specialist in the Quality and Engineering department is a highly experienced professional who takes a leadership role in quality management and technical reference. They are responsible for overseeing and directing high complex quality control processes, leading strategic improvements, and ensuring the company’s adherence to industry’s best practices and regulatory requirements.


Key Responsibilities:


  • Assist to oversee quality control and engineering processes for the landing gear MRO.
  • Develop and implement comprehensive quality improvement programs to enhance operational performance.
  • Technical guidance for analysts, ensuring compliance with internal procedures, manuals and best practices.
  • Perform advanced analysis of data, lead root cause investigations, and drive corrective and preventive actions.
  • Manage and ensure compliance with all aerospace regulations, quality certifications (ANAC, FAA, ISO 9001, etc.) and approved technical data (CMMs and other manufacture manuals).
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including operations, supply chain and planning to ensure seamless quality management.
  • Support internal and external audits, providing technical support and assistance during regulatory inspections and certifications.
  • Develop and report on key quality performance indicators, identifying areas for process optimization and cost reduction.
  • Be the technical reference in strategic decision-making regarding quality and process improvements.


Work Experience:


+5 Years of experience working in an aeronautical industry with quality and/or engineering.

Strong experience with quality auditing process (aeronautical authorities (FAA, ANAC, EASA), supplier qualification and aeronautical departments).


Educational:

Technical degree or Graduation (Engineering, Quality or Technical) concluded with Post graduation/ master’s degree in concluded.

Advanced / Fluent English is mandatory


Technical Skills:

Advanced quality tools, drawing interpretations (development is a plus), in-depth knowledge of aeronautical authorities’ regulations (FAA, EASA, ANAC) and ISO 9001 standard or related audit standard requirements.


Obs.: Office and shop floor setting in a regulated aerospace maintenance facility.

May require occasional hands-on inspections or shop visits involving PPE and exposure to aircraft components and tooling.

Work may involve tight deadlines and collaboration across departments.


Location:


100% in office position at Rio de Janeiro.

Necessário domínio do Pacote Office.

Necessário conhecimento em ferramentas de apoio a gestão de projetos e produtos.

Boa comunicação e capacidade de articular diferentes áreas e stakeholders.

Principais atividades:

title: Staff Accountant (Netsuite)
description:
SUMMARY


INTUS Windows is seeking a detail-oriented and systems-savvy NetSuite Accountant to manage the entry, accuracy, and validation of accounting data within our NetSuite ERP platform. This role plays a key part in supporting Finance and Accounting operations by ensuring clean, consistent, and well-tested financial data across all core accounting modules — including Accounts Payable (AP), Accounts Receivable (AR), General Ledger (GL), and Payroll.

The ideal candidate has a strong foundation in accounting, hands-on experience with NetSuite, and enjoys working in a structured, process-driven environment. This position is responsible for data entry, testing, reconciliations, and configuration validation within the NetSuite system.


PERFORMANCE OBJECTIVES


NetSuite Accounting Data Management


  • Enter and validate accounting-related data in NetSuite.
  • Ensure completeness and accuracy of all accounting entries in NetSuite across AR, AP, GL, and Payroll modules.
  • Conduct regular audits to identify and correct data inconsistencies or configuration issues.
  • Support daily transactional entry, adjustments, and posting of journal entries under supervision.


Testing & System Validation


  • Assist in testing accounting processes across NetSuite modules:
  • Validate system workflows for AP, AR, GL, Fixed Assets, and Payroll.
  • Perform UAT (User Acceptance Testing) during NetSuite updates or enhancements.
  • Work closely with the Accounting, Finance, and IT teams to identify and troubleshoot accounting-related system errors or configuration gaps.
  • Help document testing procedures and results for audit and compliance purposes.


Month-End & Operational Support


  • Support the month-end close process by preparing, verifying, and entering journal entries in NetSuite.
  • Assist in reconciling general ledger accounts and running reports to support financial review.
  • Ensure system data is closed and locked appropriately in accordance with internal deadlines.


Documentation & Internal Support


  • Maintain accurate documentation of system processes, data input standards, and workflows within NetSuite.
  • Assist accounting team members in navigating NetSuite functionality and resolving data entry issues.
  • Contribute to continuous improvement of NetSuite accounting procedures and controls.
  • Performs other duties as assigned.


KEY COMPETENCIES


  • Strong working knowledge of NetSuite ERP and accounting module navigation.
  • Understanding of US GAAP accounting principles.
  • Excellent attention to detail and data accuracy.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities.
  • Ability to work both independently and as part of a collaborative accounting team.
  • Capable of managing multiple tasks in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and accounting data manipulation.
  • Effective communication and organizational skills.


EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE


  • Bachelor’s degree in accounting, Finance, or a related field.
  • 2–5 years of accounting experience, with 2+ years of hands-on strong experience in NetSuite ERP.
  • Solid understanding of general accounting functions including journal entries, reconciliations, and month-end processes.
  • Experience working with accounting data across modules like AR, AP, GL, and Payroll.


WHAT WE OFFER


  • Remote work opportunity.
  • Working hours 8-5 EST (preferred).
  • Monthly gross salary within the range of $1000-$2200.
  • Participating in our "One Window - One Tree" initiative.
  • The opportunity to improve your skills through professional development training.
  • A rapidly growing company.
  • A collaborative and supportive team environment.

title: Pessoa Analista de Desenvolvimento de Sistemas Sênior Full-Stack
description:
#Nosso jeito de fazer história:

Entre para a história de construção do maior Hub de Dados e Analytics do Brasil.

Além de você contribuir diretamente neste objetivo, você estará se desenvolvendo constantemente, por meio de grandes desafios de negócio, junto a um time de alto impacto. Na Neoway, acreditamos em fazer as coisas de forma inovadora, colaborativa, responsável e com foco no cliente.

Falando da área:

Trabalhar na área de Engenharia da Neoway mantém o colaborador conectado com a inovação, ao constante aprimoramento por melhores metodologias de desenvolvimento e a novas tecnologias para atender os objetivos estratégicos e de negócios da Neoway.

Utilizamos metodologias ágeis por princípio e focamos no ciclo de desenvolvimento de produto para oferecer a melhor experiência aos nossos usuários. O time de Engenharia é responsável por construir, evoluir e sustentar todo o ecossistema que compõem nossa plataforma de Big Data Analytics, chamada Plataforma Neoway.


Acreditamos que um software de qualidade é fácil de usar, funciona corretamente, é de fácil manutenção/sustentação, fácil integração e mantém a integridade para evitar possíveis falhas, fora ou não, do controle de quem o desenvolveu.


Para alcançar este objetivo atuamos em dois pilares distintos para garantir a eficiência do processo de desenvolvimento de software assegurando a qualidade junto a um ambiente saudável na área de Engenharia, no aspecto de boas práticas e cultura de desenvolvimento:


1° - Pessoas é um pilar estratégico para Neoway, atuamos de maneira pró ativa em conjunto com todas as áreas da empresa, garantindo o desenvolvimento de talentos, crescimento profissional e formação do nosso DNA, impulsionando a cultura de times de alta performance (liberdade com responsabilidade).


2° - Técnico (Paved Way), acreditamos que ferramental e a automação ajudam a dimensionar a capacidade de um time, mas nenhuma ferramenta resolverá todos os problemas na produtividade no desenvolvimento ou nas operações. A ideia é ter um conjunto de ferramentas e práticas de “paved way” que são formalmente suportadas por algumas pessoas. Não exigimos a adoção desses “paved way” , mas incentivamos a adoção, garantindo que o desenvolvimento e as operações usando essas tecnologias sejam uma experiência muito melhor do que não usá-las.


Falando do time:

O foco do time é contribuir para a evolução estratégica da Plataforma Neoway, fornecendo às Unidades de Negócio da empresa uma série de sistemas, ferramentas e padrões que apoiam e promovem a autonomia dos demais times de desenvolvimento a acelerar suas entregas e criação de novos produtos.

Missão do cargo:

Como Pessoa Desenvolvedora de Software você fará parte de um dos times de desenvolvimento e será responsável por agregar conhecimento técnico ao time, sustentando, evoluindo ou construindo parte das soluções de nossa plataforma, garantindo a segurança, buscando soluções para situações do dia a dia, visando sempre o trabalho harmônico em equipe, a qualidade do código e da arquitetura em geral.


Como será o seu dia a dia no time:

  • Trabalhar na concepção de soluções técnicas, na quebra de tarefas, planejamento e na execução das demandas;
  • Garantir a qualidade das entregas, fomentando práticas de Code Review e desenvolvimento orientado a testes (TDD/BDD);
  • Manter, monitorar e garantir a eficiência dos serviços construídos e de responsabilidade do seu time;
  • Participar das dinâmicas de trabalho adotadas pelo time;
  • Trabalhar de forma colaborativa no processo de melhoria contínua do seu time;
  • Colaborar nas definições de arquitetura, escalabilidade e segurança dos nossos produtos;
  • Criar soluções com base em uma arquitetura distribuída e de microserviços;
  • Criar soluções resilientes, escaláveis e de alta performance;
  • Garantir desenvolvimento seguro, observando atualizações de segurança e critérios relevantes;
  • Atuar como referência técnica no time, apoiando colegas menos experientes e disseminando boas práticas.


Para assumir estas responsabilidades você precisa ter as seguintes habilidades:

  • Compreensão de arquiteturas distribuídas e de alto volume de dados (repositórios, filas, microsserviços, etc);
  • Domínio de conceitos e boas práticas de engenharia de software (da concepção à entrega, sustentação e operação, TDD, documentação, code review, etc);
  • Experiência em Go ou Node.js, com abertura para aprender outras stacks;
  • Experiência com bancos relacionais e não relacionais (PostgreSQL, MongoDB, etc);
  • Experiência com infraestrutura em Cloud (preferencialmente GCP);
  • Conhecimentos em APIs Rest, Docker e Kubernetes;
  • Programação concorrente e escalável;
  • Conhecimento em processos de versionamento e práticas de CI/CD;
  • Experiência com observabilidade (monitoramento, logging, tracing, métricas);
  • Boa comunicação e colaboração em equipe;
  • Capacidade de encarar mudanças como oportunidades e aprender com erros;
  • Facilidade em compartilhar conhecimento e atuar como mentor(a);
  • Promover nossa cultura e valores.


Alguns diferenciais que estamos de olho. Mas não se preocupe caso não tenha, ajudamos você nessa parte:

  • Conhecimento dos conceitos de Big Data, Data Lake, Metadados com perspectiva de governança de dados;
  • Experiência com front-end moderno (Vue.js, Angular, React);
  • Conhecimento de infraestrutura como código (Terraform, Ansible);
  • Conhecimento em serviços de mensageria (PubSub, SNS, Kafka);
  • Conhecimento em ferramentas de análise e busca (BigQuery, ElasticSearch).

Responsabilidades e Atribuições:


Perfil Profissional – Desenvolvedor Java | Pleno

Desenvolvedor Java com sólida experiência em sistemas distribuídos e arquitetura de microsserviços, especializado em autenticação, autorização e protocolos de segurança como OAuth2, OpenID Connect e JWT. Atua com foco no desenvolvimento de mecanismos de Single Sign-On (SSO) para ambientes corporativos, garantindo segurança, escalabilidade e conformidade com padrões modernos de identidade digital.

Com domínio em Spring Security, Spring Authorization Server, Keycloak, Azure AD, Auth0 e outras soluções de identidade, projeta fluxos de autenticação robustos e integrações seguras entre múltiplos sistemas internos e externos. Possui expertise na implementação de Identity Providers (IdP), Resource Servers e Authorization Servers, bem como na configuração de clients OAuth2 com grant types como Authorization Code, Client Credentials, e Refresh Tokens.

Também é responsável por definir estratégias de controle de acesso baseado em roles (RBAC) e atributos (ABAC), configuração de políticas de autorização, integração com diretórios corporativos (LDAP, AD), e hardening de endpoints REST com escopos e claims personalizados.

Competências Técnicas

Linguagem: Java 8–21

Frameworks: Spring Boot, Spring Security, Spring Authorization Server, Apache Camel

SSO & Identity: OAuth2, OpenID Connect, JWT, SAML 2.0, Keycloak, Auth0, Azure Active Directory, Okta

Segurança: Criptografia, JWK/JWS, HTTPS/TLS, CORS, CSRF, PKCE

Integrações: LDAP, Active Directory, SCIM

Testes: Testcontainers, JUnit, Mockito, integração com testes de segurança

DevOps: Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD com Jenkins, GitLab ou GitHub Actions

Diferenciais

Experiência na migração de sistemas legados para arquiteturas modernas com SSO.

Atuação direta no desenho e implementação de Identity Providers e Authorization Servers próprios.

Capacidade de liderar times na definição de padrões de autenticação e segurança em ambientes corporativos.

Vivência com compliance de segurança, como LGPD e GDPR, aplicando princípios de privacy-by-design.

Diferencial: com conhecimento em Autenticação, Autorização e SSO com OAuth2Habilidades:

- Java

- Spring Boot

- Spring Security

- Spring Authorization Server

- OAuth2

- OpenID Connect

- JWT

- Keycloak

- Azure Active Directory

- Docker

- Kubernetes


Softskills:


- Autonomia, Proatividade e Iniciativa

- Boa comunicação e trabalho em equipe

title: Game Designer (Mid to Senior)
description:
Location: Remote (Brazil-based) 

Employment type: Full-time (CLT) 

Language: Portuguese (fluent), English (professional working proficiency)

Salary Range:  R$7K – R$12K

762 Interactive is looking for a Game Designer to join our studio and help bring to life Project Kingpin, an ambitious and fresh take on crime-strategy and management games. We’re searching for someone with strong gameplay instincts, creative systems thinking, and a passion for designing mechanics that are strategic, rewarding, and authentic. You’ll work across gameplay systems, economy, and progression to shape how players experience the world we are building. This role requires both hands-on design work and collaboration across disciplines.


This is a remote position.

Please do not apply if you do not have prior game development experience.  

In This Role You Will:

  • Design and document core gameplay systems, loops, and progression structures.
  • Balance player rewards, pacing, and progression using data and playtesting.
  • Write and maintain clear design documentation (GDDs, feature briefs, tuning sheets).
  • Collaborate closely with developers, artists, and production to prototype and refine mechanics.
  • Participate in playtests and iterate based on player feedback.
  • Contribute ideas across mission design, economy systems, and player experience.
  • Help define design processes and best practices as part of a growing studio.


What We are Looking For:

  • 3+ years of professional experience in game design.
  • Proven experience with gameplay systems, progression, or balancing.
  • Strong analytical thinking and ability to translate creative ideas into testable mechanics.
  • Proficiency with Excel/Sheets for tuning and balancing.
  • Knowledge of Unity editor & autonomy to use the scriptable objects
  • Clear, structured writing and documentation skills.
  • Can think and work creatively while taking the initiative to solve problems. 
  • Strong communication skills and ability to collaborate cross-discipline. 
  • Self-motivated, strong work ethic, and able to work independently. 
  • Drive towards professional growth. 
  • Fluent in Portuguese; English proficiency for daily communication with U.S. leadership.


Nice to Have:

  • Experience with strategy / sim / management games is very welcome. 
  • UI/UX Design Experience.
  • Knowledge of C# in the Unity Engine.
  • Knowledge of AI behavior, or mission scripting.
  • Understanding of Unity implementation or prototyping workflows.
  • Interest in narrative-driven systems or branching gameplay.


What We Offer:

  • Competitive salary 
  • CLT Contract with Benefits (including Health Insurance, Monthly Meal Voucher, & Monthly Internet / Home Office Voucher)  
  • Remote-first culture 
  • Clear growth path: opportunities to advance your career as we scale the team and build the studio. 
  • Opportunity to shape the foundation of the studio and game from the ground up. 
  • Creative environment where your voice and ideas matter.

Além disso, se posiciona como ponto focal para atendimento de dúvidas dos times de Produto, Operações e Comercial, suportando também testes, documentações e estudos de novos processos.




O que você irá fazer:

  • Promover a contínua comunicação com os principais stakeholders internos para a manutenção dos critérios técnicos na sustentabilidade dos processos recorrentes nos produtos.
  • Garantir em metodologia e execução a manutenção de processos já validados e em operação nos produtos em que o time possui atuação.
  • Atuar nas inclusões, revisões e atualizações metodológicas propostas pelo time e/ou demandadas por Produto e Comercial dos processos relacionados com métodos de integração de dados para os produtos do Portfólio.
  • Mapear, desenvolver e apoiar o desenvolvimento de análises e testes de novos processos dos produtos de Audiência de TV e Cross Media.
  • Propor e desenvolver controles de qualidade com o objetivo de garantir e certificar o pleno funcionamento de etapas de processos internos e/ou externos associados aos produtos e cobertos pelo escopo do time.
  • Mapear oportunidades em que a automação pode promover melhora significativa na qualidade e/ ou eficiência de processos.
  • Propor e desenvolver técnicas e aplicações de automação para atividades recorrentes na equipe ou executadas por áreas de interface e que impactem os processos da equipe.
  • Monitorar de forma contínua o mercado de Inteligência Artificial, com objetivo de identificar e implementar soluções que visem inovação, melhoria e/ou eficiência.
  • Fomentar de forma constante a inovação e melhoria contínua em temas relacionados à área, estando constantemente ativo na busca e curadoria de novas práticas e aberto a ouvir propostas de outros membros da equipe.
  • Contribuir para o crescimento de cada membro da equipe, estando sempre disponível para troca de ideias, explicações e compartilhamento de conhecimento.




O que buscamos?

  • Formação Superior em Estatística, Matemática ou áreas correlatas.
  • Desejável experiência na indústria de publicidade e/ou mídia.
  • Fundamental experiência em linguagens de programação como Python e R.
  • Desejável conhecimento em ferramentas de visualização de dados integradas ao Python, R ou como o Power BI.
  • Desejável conhecimento em plataformas para uso de dados em nuvem, como Azure Databricks.
